fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/ListingPages/PopularTruck.cy.js#ListingPages - NewListingPages [popularTrucks] [en] — Popular Truck TC-NLP-03: Contact Seller lead submits successfully on Popular Truck
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NLP-03
**Title:** Contact Seller lead submits successfully on Popular Truck
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Popular Truck listing page, click Contact Seller to open its lead form, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A “Thank You For Contact” confirmation is shown after a successful Contact Seller submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Popular Truck listing page
2. Click Contact Seller to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the confirmation
